question_text: Name two important ideas from the Declaration of Independence and the U.S. Constitution.
lead_in: Six big ideas appear in both documents — name any two:

why_it_matters.text: These ideas weren't normal at the time. Most countries were ruled by kings who claimed God put them in charge. The American documents said the opposite: power comes from people, government is limited, and rights belong to everyone. That was the radical bet.

fun_fact.text: When colonists said power comes from 'the consent of the governed,' they flipped centuries of European thinking upside down. Most kings claimed God put them in charge. Americans said: actually, you only get to lead if we let you. That single idea changed how the world thinks about government.
